validity.researcher_notes: Started from the sheet's own current ref (EoI23112020.pdf) and the wiki's two citations (same PDF + a generic PNGRB data-bank link). EXISTENCE is real and well documented: PNGRB's own EOI/public-notice registry page (pngrb.gov.in/eng-web/NG-eoi.html) lists, verbatim, 'Expression of Interest submitted by GAIL to develop Natural Gas Pipeline from Kondalapalli - Tirupati (Andhra Pradesh)', Notice No. PNGRB/Auth/2-NGPL(17)/2020, dated 23.11.2020 -- an official regulatory record, not a GEM-derived or aggregate mention. PNGRB's own Public Notice PDF for that same reference number (PN23112020.pdf, a genuine text PDF, read with pdftotext since url_verifier's PDF byte-stream can't be substring-matched) independently confirms: 'Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board has received an Expression of Interest ... from GAIL (India) Limited to lay, build, operate or expand Natural Gas pipeline from Kondalapalli - Tirupati (Andhra Pradesh)', with a 30-day public consultation window closing 23.12.2020 and an open-house session scheduled 04.01.2021. GAIL's own EOI cover letter, which IS the sheet's current ref (EoI23112020.pdf, an image-only scan, OCR'd with tesseract since it has no text layer and url_verifier's PDF check cannot reach it either) confirms the same submission from the sponsor's side, dated 17.11.2020, spelling the origin town 'Kondapalli' rather than PNGRB/GEM's 'Kondalapalli' -- both are transliterations of the same Krishna-district town near Vijayawada (home of Kondapalli Fort); this is a spelling variant, not a different place or a data error, and PNGRB's own listing already uses GEM's spelling. IMPORTANT DATA-QUALITY NOTE ON THE CURRENT REF: EoI23112020.pdf as served by PNGRB is a 9-page bundle in which only page 1 (GAIL's cover letter) concerns Kondalapalli-Tirupati -- pages 2-7 are H-Energy Private Limited's unrelated Schedule-A application form for the Kukrahati-Itinda pipeline (dated Jan 2018, referencing a different project entirely), and pages 8-9 are GAIL's net-worth certificate (presumably Annexure-3 of GAIL's own filing). This looks like a PNGRB-side scanning/bundling artifact, not a GEM error, but it means the current ref does NOT and cannot contain Schedule-A technical details (route length, capacity, demand projections) for THIS project -- it only supports the bare fact that GAIL submitted an EOI. CLASSIFICATION: Fuel=Gas and PipelineType=transmission are correctly recorded -- this is an NGPL Authorization Regulations 2008 Reg. 4(1) trunk-pipeline EOI, not a gathering/CGD filing. DUPLICATE check against the 13-row roster: no other row shares this corridor (Kondalapalli/Vijayawada to Tirupati is a distinct inland north-south Andhra route, geographically separate from P0932 Kakinada-Vizag-Srikakulam's coastal-north corridor and P3342's Kakinada-Haldia long-haul route). Checked the current (most recent, 2026-05-31) PNGRB NGPL MIS Report -- the live authorized-pipeline register -- and confirmed no Kondalapalli/Kondapalli-Tirupati or Vijayawada-Tirupati line appears among either operating or under-construction authorizations; the only Vijayawada-adjacent line in that register is 'Kakinada-Vijayawada-Nellore' (IMC, 667 km, authorized 19.02.2018) -- a different sponsor and route, so not a same-identity duplicate, but flagged above for the redundancy step since Nellore sits on the geographic path toward Tirupati. Checked all ~20 archived PNGRB NG bid-round listing pages (eng-web/ng-bid-1.html through ng-bid-20.html) for 'Kondalapalli'/'Kondapalli'/'Tirupati' -- zero hits, confirming this EOI never advanced to a competitive bid round (unlike some other EOIs on the same registry page, which do show follow-on Comment/BID links). ATTRIBUTION: Owner1=GAIL (India) Ltd 100% is directly confirmed by both the EOI cover letter and the PNGRB registry entry (GAIL is the sole EOI submitter; no competing bid emerged). Overall: real, correctly classified, correctly attributed, non-duplicate proposal that stalled at the initial EOI/public-consultation stage in late 2020/early 2021 and never became an authorized project -- see status_reviews for the cancellation-vocabulary finding.

Both PNGRB and GAIL confirm the route is wholly within Andhra Pradesh, India.

PNGRB's registry entry independently states 'Expression of Interest submitted by GAIL'. No competing bidder ever surfaced (confirmed no comment/bid follow-through on the registry page, and no bid-round listing mentions this corridor), so there is no ownership dispute -- 100% GAIL is correct for this never-authorized proposal. contains_value is false on both because 'GAIL' inside a PDF byte-stream and a Comment/BID-toggle-heavy HTML page aren't reliably substring-matched by the automated screen; confirmed manually.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: No explicit cancellation/withdrawal notice was found anywhere on PNGRB's site -- this is an INFERRED dormancy call, not a confirmed one, and closes one of the 8 blank-ShelvedCancelledType gaps flagged for this cluster. Timeline: GAIL filed the EOI 17.11.2020; PNGRB opened public consultation 23.11.2020, closing 23.12.2020, with an open-house session held 04.01.2021 (all per the Public Notice PDF). PNGRB's own EOI registry page shows NO follow-on activity for this Notice No. (PNGRB/Auth/2-NGPL(17)/2020) beyond that -- the page's Comment/MAP/BID link slots for this row are empty/disabled, unlike several other rows on the same page that do carry populated comment PDFs or bid links. I checked all ~20 archived PNGRB NG bid-round listing pages (ng-bid-1.html through ng-bid-20.html): zero mentions of Kondalapalli/Kondapalli/Tirupati, meaning it never converted to either a negotiated authorization or a competitive bid. As of the most current PNGRB register available (NGPL MIS Report, 31-May-2026 edition -- the live authorized-pipeline list), no Kondalapalli/Kondapalli-Tirupati line appears among operating or under-construction authorizations. IMPORTANT CAVEAT per the country brief's warning: absence from the register alone proves nothing (it only lists live authorizations, and this project never got one in the first place) -- what actually supports dormancy here is the combination of (a) zero follow-through on PNGRB's own EOI-tracking page over 5+ years, and (b) zero appearance in any bid round. That is dated evidence of abandonment at the EOI stage, not merely an absence. Given >4 years with no progress past the initial public-consultation step (Dec 2020/Jan 2021 to present, 2026-05), the dormancy rule's shelved->cancelled threshold (4y) is comfortably met, supporting the ALREADY-RECORDED Status=cancelled -- no status change needed, only the vocabulary gap: ShelvedCancelledType should be 'inferred' (not 'confirmed', since no source states an explicit withdrawal, and definitely not 'Presumed', which is not valid vocabulary) and CancelledYear is left unset rather than guessed, since no discrete cancellation date exists to pair with it -- only a stall window (Dec 2020-Jan 2021) is documented, not a formal cancellation event.

summary: P2752 is a genuine GAIL EOI (17.11.2020, PNGRB Notice PNGRB/Auth/2-NGPL(17)/2020) for a Kondalapalli(Kondapalli)-Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh gas pipeline that stalled after the initial public-consultation stage and never reached authorization or a bid round (checked all ~20 PNGRB bid-round pages, zero hits; absent from the current 2026-05 NGPL MIS Report) -- correctly classified, correctly attributed to GAIL 100%, not a duplicate of any other roster row; Status=cancelled is confirmed as an INFERRED dormancy call (staged ShelvedCancelledType=inferred, no fabricated cancellation ref) rather than a confirmed withdrawal; Location and Owner refs added; Capacity (4.00 MMSCMD) and LengthKnown (450 km) remain UNRESOLVED -- no independent source states either figure, and the sheet's current ref PDF is a PNGRB-side bundling artifact whose non-cover pages belong to an unrelated H-Energy filing.
